op_note: op=resave carries saved_config + saved_field_order + the exact localStorage bytes the composition wrote (storage_expected) and the baseline page wrote (storage_actual); op=launch-side values (argv, serverPath, serverPort) are composed from the recorded DOM state and cross-checked against the recorded POST /start bytes; op=create and op=alert-blocked are recorded-only (create is written by saveConfiguration, not saveCurrentValues; alert-blocked configs never posted anything, so argv is null and the recorded native dialog text is the expectation)
edge_note: op=resave-edge is the save-channel kill input for the mutation inventory: the same baseline re-save with form values the 48 real configs never produce (every numeric field emptied, chat-template kwargs filled). Composed and cross-checked exactly like op=resave, but it drives no launch, so it carries no argv. tools/parity/mutation-run.js scores the `save` region over op=resave + op=resave-edge.
ini_note: ini is base64 of a single-config ini built from the saved config (ini_from_saved), and ini_after_resave the same bytes rebuilt from the entry the re-save wrote — the difference is Q16 (orphan keys dropped, loadMode/reasoning migrated in)
